title: Hedging and connecting
focus: 似乎 · 按理说 · 话说回来 · 再说 · 总之 · 尽管 · 换句话说 · 不见得
body:
# Hedging and connecting

Small connecting phrases that make you sound like an adult: hedging, adding a reason, summing up, and taking something back. They glue sentences together in real conversation.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 似乎 | sìhū | seemingly / it seems (somewhat formal) | resembling → seemingly (formal 好像) |
| 按理说 | ànlǐ shuō | logically / normally (it should be ..., but) | speaking according to reason |
| 话说回来 | huà shuō huílai | that said / having said that | bring the talk back around |
| 再说 | zàishuō | besides / what's more (adding another reason) | say something further → besides |
| 总之 | zǒngzhī | in short / anyway (to sum up) | total it up → in short |
| 尽管 | jǐnguǎn | even though / despite (stronger than 'although') | go ahead fully → even though |
| 换句话说 | huàn jù huà shuō | in other words (rephrasing, literally 'say it with other words') | swap the sentence, say it again |
| 不见得 | bújiànde | not necessarily (spoken, skeptical) | can't be seen → not necessarily |

## Which word?

**总之 vs 反正**: 总之 sums up what was said; 反正 means 'whatever happens, regardless'.

**换句话说 vs 也就是说 (L3)**: 换句话说 says the same thing more plainly; 也就是说 draws out what it implies.

## Sentences

- 按理说他早该恢复了，怎么还在咳嗽？ ànlǐ shuō tā zǎo gāi huīfù le, zěnme hái zài késou: He should have recovered long ago. Why is he still coughing?
- 尽管进展不错，领导似乎还是不太满意。 jǐnguǎn jìnzhǎn búcuò, lǐngdǎo sìhū háishi bú tài mǎnyì: Even though progress is good, the boss still doesn't seem very happy.
- 他是有点固执，不过话说回来，做事确实靠谱。 tā shì yǒudiǎn gùzhí, búguò huà shuō huílai, zuòshì quèshí kàopǔ: He is a bit stubborn, but that said, he's really reliable.
- 这房子太远，再说也不划算。 zhè fángzi tài yuǎn, zàishuō yě bù huásuàn: This place is too far, and besides, it's not good value.
- 总之，贵的不见得就好。 zǒngzhī, guì de bújiànde jiù hǎo: Anyway (to sum up), expensive doesn't necessarily mean good.
- 尽管条件不好，他还是按时完成了。 jǐnguǎn tiáojiàn bù hǎo, tā háishi ànshí wánchéng le: Even though conditions were bad, he still finished on time.
- 他说“以后再说”，换句话说，就是不想去。 tā shuō "yǐhòu zàishuō", huàn jù huà shuō, jiù shì bù xiǎng qù: He said "we'll see later". In other words, he doesn't want to go.
- 体检正常，也不见得就没事。 tǐjiǎn zhèngcháng, yě bújiànde jiù méi shì: A normal checkup doesn't necessarily mean you're fine.

cards.Example: 他似乎不太同意这个安排。 tā sìhū bú tài tóngyì zhège ānpái: He doesn't seem to agree with this arrangement
cards.Notes: 似 sì resemble (相似, 好似) + 乎 hū classical particle (几乎 almost) = resembling: seemingly. 好像 (像 resemble) is the everyday word; 似乎 sounds more careful and measured.

cards.Example: 按理说他早该到了，怎么还没来？ ànlǐ shuō tā zǎo gāi dào le, zěnme hái méi lái: He should have been here ages ago, why isn't he here yet?
cards.Notes: 按 àn according to, press, 扌 hand (按照, 按门铃) + 理 lǐ reason (道理, 有理) + 说 say = speaking according to reason. Sets up an expectation that turned out wrong.

cards.Example: 这工作很累，不过话说回来，工资确实高。 zhè gōngzuò hěn lèi, búguò huà shuō huílai, gōngzī quèshí gāo: The job is exhausting, but that said, the pay really is good
cards.Notes: 话 huà talk (说话) + 说回来 say back = bring the talk back around: that said. Often after 不过 or 但是.

cards.Example: 今天太晚了，再说外面还在下雨，明天再去吧。 jīntiān tài wǎn le, zàishuō wàimiàn hái zài xià yǔ, míngtiān zài qù ba: It's too late today, and besides it's raining; let's go tomorrow
cards.Notes: 再 zài again, further (再见) + 说 say = say something further: besides. Also 'deal with it later': 以后再说.

cards.Example: 总之，这件事你别管了。 zǒngzhī, zhè jiàn shì nǐ bié guǎn le: Anyway, just stay out of this
cards.Notes: 总 zǒng total, overall (总是, 总共) + 之 zhī it (classical) = to total it up: in short. 总之 sums up; 反正 = 'whatever happens / regardless'.

cards.Example: 尽管很累，他还是把活儿干完了。 jǐnguǎn hěn lèi, tā háishi bǎ huór gàn wán le: Even though he was exhausted, he still finished the job
cards.Notes: 尽 jǐn to the utmost (尽量, 尽快) + 管 guǎn mind, concern (不管, 别管) = go ahead fully, never mind: even though. Pattern: 尽管……还是……. 尽管 + verb alone = feel free to: 有事尽管说.

cards.English: in other words (rephrasing, literally 'say it with other words')
cards.Example: 公司要“优化”人员，换句话说，就是要裁员。 gōngsī yào "yōuhuà" rényuán, huàn jù huà shuō, jiù shì yào cáiyuán: The company wants to 'optimize' staff; in other words, layoffs
cards.Notes: 换 huàn swap, 扌 hand (换衣服, 交换) + 句 jù sentence (句子) + 话说 say = swap the sentence and say it: in other words. Restates the same thing more plainly.

cards.Example: 他嘴上说好，不见得真会去做。 tā zuǐ shàng shuō hǎo, bújiànde zhēn huì qù zuò: He says yes, but that doesn't mean he'll actually do it
cards.Notes: 不 not + 见得 jiànde can be seen (见 see, 看见) = it can't be seen that...: not necessarily. Sounds doubtful; 未必 is more neutral and formal.

cards.English: He should have recovered long ago. Why is he still coughing?
cards.Hanzi: 按理说他早该恢复了，怎么还在咳嗽？
cards.Pinyin: ànlǐ shuō tā zǎo gāi huīfù le, zěnme hái zài késou?
cards.Notes: 按理说 (L14) + 恢复 (L13). 按理说 sets up an expectation that turned out wrong.

cards.English: Even though progress is good, the boss still doesn't seem very happy.
cards.Hanzi: 尽管进展不错，领导似乎还是不太满意。
cards.Pinyin: jǐnguǎn jìnzhǎn búcuò, lǐngdǎo sìhū háishi bú tài mǎnyì.
cards.Notes: 尽管 (L14) + 似乎 (L14) + 进展 (L10) + 领导 (L6). Pattern: 尽管……还是……

cards.English: He is a bit stubborn, but that said, he's really reliable.
cards.Hanzi: 他是有点固执，不过话说回来，做事确实靠谱。
cards.Pinyin: tā shì yǒudiǎn gùzhí, búguò huà shuō huílai, zuòshì quèshí kàopǔ.
cards.Notes: 话说回来 (L14) + 固执 (L12) + 靠谱 (L12) + 确实 (L1). Stressed 是 = 'admittedly, he is'.

cards.English: This place is too far, and besides, it's not good value.
cards.Hanzi: 这房子太远，再说也不划算。
cards.Pinyin: zhè fángzi tài yuǎn, zàishuō yě bù huásuàn.
cards.Notes: 再说 (L14) + 划算 (L9). 再说 adds one more reason.

cards.English: Anyway (to sum up), expensive doesn't necessarily mean good.
cards.Pinyin: zǒngzhī, guì de bújiànde jiù hǎo.
cards.Notes: 总之 (L14) + 不见得 (L14). 不见得 sounds skeptical; 未必 is more neutral.

cards.English: Even though conditions were bad, he still finished on time.
cards.Hanzi: 尽管条件不好，他还是按时完成了。
cards.Pinyin: jǐnguǎn tiáojiàn bù hǎo, tā háishi ànshí wánchéng le.
cards.Notes: 尽管 (L14) + 条件 (L11) + 按时 (L10). 尽管 is stronger than 虽然.

cards.English: He said "we'll see later". In other words, he doesn't want to go.
cards.Hanzi: 他说“以后再说”，换句话说，就是不想去。
cards.Pinyin: tā shuō "yǐhòu zàishuō", huàn jù huà shuō, jiù shì bù xiǎng qù.
cards.Notes: 换句话说 (L14) + 再说 (L14). 以后再说 = 'deal with it later', often a polite no.

cards.English: A normal checkup doesn't necessarily mean you're fine.
cards.Hanzi: 体检正常，也不见得就没事。
cards.Pinyin: tǐjiǎn zhèngcháng, yě bújiànde jiù méi shì.
cards.Notes: 不见得 (L14) + 体检 (L13). 不见得 + 就 = doesn't automatically follow.
